narrative:
Material PL3__M803CD2B exhibits erratic demand patterns with a coefficient of variation of 0.63. 
The analysis of 228 working days reveals a mean daily demand of 2893 units with significant variability (std: 1814).

Lead time analysis shows volatile behavior (CV: 0.32) with mean 5.19 days and std 1.67 days. 
Lead time variability contributes 57.7% to total uncertainty, making it the dominant factor in safety stock requirements.

The recommended safety stock of 10,459 units provides 95% service level protection.
The optimized order quantity of 52,435 units balances ordering costs ($1390.52/year) 
with holding costs ($59.25/year), resulting in total annual costs of $1449.78.

Compared to current SAP policy (safety stock: 15,033), the recommended policy reduces inventory by 
4,574 units while maintaining service levels, yielding $7.39 in annual savings (0.51%).

The capacity utilization is 100.0%, providing adequate buffer for operational flexibility.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Continuous review (Q,R) model selected due to erratic demand regime (CV=0.63) and volatile lead time (CV=0.32)
research_insights.boundary_risk: Capacity utilization at 100% - limited buffer for demand spikes
